description: Distributed Energy Resources Dispatch Considering a Hydrogen Power Plant - 37 bus grid dataset is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Luis Rodrigues. Data set for simulating the operation of a hydrogen power plant in a distribution grid with a high penetration of distributed energy sources. Includes: 1. Single-line diagram of the distribution grid. 2. Input data: seasonal PV generation profiles (22 PV systems). 3. Input data: seasonal wind generation profiles (2 wind farms). 4. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
